Name: Velvet Veil Farm - Custom Farm Map
Author: calimistra
Description:
Adds a new customizable farm map with multiple toggleable patches. Not a replacer of one of the vanilla maps.

Featured toggles, bold are default values (for ease of use consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]):
Colored Spring Leaves ([b]Disable[/b], Purple (Bright), Pink (Bright), Purple (Desaturated), Pink (Desaturated)) - Changes leaves to a pink-ish or purple-ish color in Spring. Affects all foliage on all maps, not just on farm map.
Grass Field ([b]true[/b], false) - ﻿Choose between grass or dirt for the main farm field. Disable for dirt.
Bridge ([b]true[/b], false) - Choose between a bridge or solid ground connecting top part of map. Disable for grassy overpath.

Table and Flooring ([b]true[/b], false) - Adds a table, flooring and decorations near the house.
Dog House ([b]true[/b], false) - Adds a dog house near the cave entrance.

Secret Woods Warp ([b]true[/b], false) - Adds a secret woods entrance in the bottom left corner of the map.
Rewspawnable Tree Stumps ([b]true[/b], false) - Adds two respawnable tree stumps in the bottom left corner.
Rewspawnable Ore ([b]true[/b], false) - Adds respawnable ores and stones.
Starting Gift (Vanilla, [b]Strawberries[/b], Sprinkler, Boots) - Choose a starting gift (BEFORE starting a save)  - Vanilla (15 parsnips), 4 Strawberry Seeds, 1 Quality Sprinkler or some fancy Boots.

Also has a warp to Grandpa's Shed from SVE if the mod is installed.
Let me know if you encounter any issues!
